jobs.title: Digital Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Nerdio**

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

**About the role**

Nerdio is hiring a Digital Program Manager to orchestrate the scaled customer experience across Customer Success. You will own the automated journeys end to end, and act as an internal consultant to the rest of the CS organization: finding friction in the customer journey and removing it with automation and agentic AI.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success and work alongside the Pooled CS team, but your reach is wider: the plays you build are designed for reuse across Customer Success, so customers get one seamless experience no matter who owns the moment. This is a builder role with no named book of business. You bring the ownership and customer-first urgency of a CAM or TAM to cross-functional programs, and you are comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity.

**What you'll do**

**Orchestrate the scaled customer experience**

* Own the digital journey from onboarding through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion readiness. Build, launch, monitor, and iterate the plays and automations at each stage.
* Build the triggers and handoffs that bring in a CAM or TAM at the right moment (health thresholds, renewal risk, expansion signals, escalations, champion changes, customer requests), following the coverage model set by the strategy lead.
* Deliver against the current and future-state journey maps owned by the strategy lead. Surface the friction points you find in the data and in the field, and close them so the experience feels the same regardless of who owns the moment.

**Act as an internal consultant to Customer Success**

* Lead discovery with CS teams: ticket analysis, stakeholder interviews, and data review to find where manual, repetitive, or inconsistent work hurts customers or burns CAM/TAM capacity.
* Recommend and build the fix: automation, signal-based triggers, and agentic AI. Give teams plays they can turn on today.

**Lead agentic AI and automation**

* Move the program from static plays to adaptive, agentic journeys for higher-complexity moments, such as personalized onboarding and automated EBR/TVR one-pagers.
* Equip CAMs and TAMs with agentic insights that make their jobs easier and return capacity to them.
* Evaluate tools, run pilots, and set guardrails so AI-driven touches are accurate, on-brand, and hand off to a human when one is needed.

**Run the program and the partnerships**

* Own program and project management from discovery to launch to iteration: scope, plan, sequence, and keep a current view of the roadmap, status, and dependencies.
* Partner with Marketing on every lifecycle communication, RevOps on segmentation and metrics, Product on telemetry and in-app messaging, Support on ticket signals, and Sales on expansion.
* Prove impact. Tie each play to NRR, adoption, and risk reduction, run test-and-learn cycles, and share results broadly.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in digital customer success, lifecycle or adoption marketing, CS operations, or program management for a scaled customer segment.
* A track record of leading cross-functional programs from idea to launch and influencing partners without direct authority.
* A consultative approach: you can run discovery, facilitate working sessions, and turn what you hear into a prioritized plan.
* Hands-on experience with CS, marketing automation, or CRM platforms, and the ability to build or configure automated journeys.
* Practical experience with, or strong curiosity about, AI agents and LLM-based workflows, and sound judgment on where AI should and should not act.
* Data fluency: you use product telemetry, health scores, and attribution to choose what to build and show what worked.
* Strong prioritization, risk management, and written and verbal communication for audiences from CAMs to executives.
* A builder mentality and comfort with ambiguity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, cloud, or the Microsoft and MSP ecosystem.
* Experience with Partner Success or Support operations.
* Hands-on use of no-code or low-code agent builders and prompt design.

**Benefits and Incentives**

* Competitive Base and Incentive Plan
* Stock Options
* Health and Welfare Plans\*
* Life and Disability Plans\*
* Retirement Plan\*
* Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off!
* Collaborative Team Culture
* Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country.

Nerdio is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Nerdio is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
***We always do the right thing, the right way.***
==================================================

**Job Title: Senior Project Manager**

**Location:** Remote

**Department:** Engineering

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Compensation**: $120,000 – $145,000 + 10% AIP per year

**Summary:**

At Aptiv Interconnect, we inspire the world's most innovative teams by doing the right thing, the right way. We are seeking a strategic, high-caliber Project Manager to drive the execution of new product development and commercialization initiatives across multiple operating divisions.

Operating at the critical intersection of technical execution and business strategy, you will coordinate cross-functional teams spanning Engineering, Operations, Product Management, Sales, and Quality to deliver complex programs on time, within scope, and aligned with company goals. This role requires a hands-on, technically fluent, and highly organized professional capable of managing multiple parallel initiatives while driving clear accountability, risk mitigation, and continuous process improvement to advance our market leadership.

**Leadership & Core Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Project Management & Lifecycle Ownership**

* End-to-End Execution: Lead the complete project lifecycle from concept through commercial launch, ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and fully aligned with business objectives.
* Cross-Functional Governance: Facilitate design reviews, tollgate meetings, and post-project evaluations while supporting the implementation of stage-gate product development processes and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Technical Execution**

* Team Coordiation & Communication: Lead and align cross-functional teams across Engineering, Operations, Product Management, Sales, and Quality, serving as a key liaison between Core Engineering and division-level stakeholders.
* Risk Mitigation & Resource Planning: Develop and maintain project schedules, resource plans, and risk registers to proactively identify and mitigate technical, resource, or timeline risks.

**Position Requirements:**

**Education & Technical Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, or a related field (Advanced degree preferred).
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive project management experience in a technical or manufacturing environment, with proven experience managing new product development (NPD) and commercialization projects.
* Industry Domain: Strong familiarity with product development methodologies, phase-gate processes, and engineering documentation practices.
* Regulatory Compliance: Citizenship status must be compliant with ITAR regulations (U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident/Green Card holder required).

**Certifications & Competencies:**

* Certifications: PMP certification or equivalent preferred.
* Systems Proficiency: Proficient in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, etc.).
* Core Competencies: Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills; hands-on problem solver with strong accountability, strategic decision-making, and multi-program management capabilities.

**Compensation, Benefits & Legal:**

**Total Rewards & Compensation**

* **Base Salary Range:** $120,000 – $145,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.
* **Incentive Compensation:** Performance bonus eligibility.
* **Benefits & Perks:** Employees receive a comprehensive benefits package featuring health coverage, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and career development resources.

**EEO Statement**

Aptiv is an Equal Opportunity Employer (Minorities/Women/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities). We adhere to all federal, state, and local laws governing non-discrimination and strictly prohibit workplace harassment of any kind.

  
  
Compensation: DOE

jobs.description:

* Lead productive working sessions with reviewed analysis, clear options, recommended actions, and specific decisions or inputs needed from the client.
* Oversee project schedules and, where required, integrated master schedules; evaluate dependencies, assumptions, critical milestones, and recovery options with qualified technical leads.
* Establish relevant program performance measures, monitor results, and use evidence to drive process improvements and verify corrective-action effectiveness.

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Data/Analytics, or a related field.

* Practical experience managing budget, schedule, and performance risks, supported by specific examples of resolving significant delivery barriers and achieving measurable results.

* Advanced degree in a relevant discipline or specialized certifications in Agile delivery, DevOps, continuous process improvement, or a related field.

**Clearance Level**:

* Must possess an active Secret Clearance (or higher).

**Location**:

* Remote.

**Salary Range**:

* The salary range for this position is $165,000 - 190,000 commensurate with experience and achievement.

**Benefit Information:**

A3 Consulting offers a robust benefits package to include but not limited to medical, dental, and vision benefits, flexible spending and health savings accounts, group life and AD&D, short-term and long-term disability, paid time off, 401k match, paid parental leave, professional development.

jobs.title: Program Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is seeking a Program Manager to join the Data and Scientific Computing Service for Sustainment of GenISIS Team. The Program Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing the work of approximately 20+ technical professionals, including software developers, system administrators, and infrastructure support personnel. This individual ensures that projects, operational activities, and technical deliverables are completed on schedule, within scope, and in accordance with established quality standards.

The successful candidate will establish clear priorities, manage competing demands, track progress, identify risks, resolve project impediments, and communicate status to leadership and stakeholders. The position requires a strong foundation in project management, the ability to work effectively with diverse technical teams, and the leadership skills necessary to promote collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects and operational responsibilities in a dynamic technical environment.

This role is a fully remote position within the United States with core hours of operation from Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM ET.

Responsibilities:

* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and resource assignments.
* Break complex technical initiatives into manageable tasks with clear owners and deadlines.
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously and manage dependencies across development and systems administration teams.
* Monitor progress against established schedules and proactively address delays or resource conflicts.
* Ensure deliverables meet defined requirements, quality standards, and customer expectations.
* Maintain project documentation, action items, decisions, and change requests
* Establish clear expectations for task ownership, deadlines, status reporting, and deliverables.
* Conduct regular team meetings, project reviews, and individual follow-ups as appropriate.
* Identify workload imbalances and coordinate resources to address changing priorities.
* Understand the software development lifecycle, including requirements, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Understand systems administration responsibilities, including server and infrastructure management, operating systems, networking, storage, backups, security, patching, and system availability.
* Ensure development and infrastructure teams work together to resolve technical dependencies and operational issues.
* Track system support requests, operational tasks, defects, and technical debt.
* Prepare concise, accurate project status reports for leadership and stakeholders.
* Track milestones, schedule performance, resource utilization, risks, issues, and deliverable completion.
* Communicate project progress, upcoming deadlines, dependencies, and potential delays.
* Identify project risks, schedule conflicts, resource constraints, and potential delivery issues early.
* Develop mitigation plans and recommend corrective actions.
* Establish consistent project management practices, reporting standards, and documentation procedures.
* Improve task tracking, workflow management, resource allocation, and team communication.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 12 years of program management or technical program coordination experience.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating technical teams, preferably consisting of 10 or more professionals.
* Experience working with both software development and IT infrastructure or systems administration teams.
* Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling, task tracking, risk management, and status reporting.
* Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or similar platforms.
* Excellent written, verbal, organizational, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Ability to identify problems, make informed decisions, and drive issues to resolution.

**Clearance Required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* PMP, CAPM, or comparable project management certification.
* Experience managing teams in government, research, scientific computing, enterprise IT, or other complex technical environments.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and traditional project management methodologies.
* Experience with infrastructure operations, Linux or Windows administration, networking, storage, cloud platforms, or high-performance computing environments.
* Experience preparing executive-level status reports, performance metrics, and project documentation.
* Familiarity with IT service management, incident management, change management, and configuration management practices.

Posted Salary Range: USD $170,000.00 - USD $180,000.00 /Yr.

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

The position will work closely with the Lighthouse Client Services team, Account Management, Client Success, Spectra team, other Lighthouse teams such as Information Governance, Digital Forensics, Review Management, etc., client, and client’s vendors to achieve these objectives.

At Abbott, we're committed to helping people with heart failure live longer, healthier lives through innovative medical technologies and digital solutions. Our products support clinicians in making informed treatment decisions and help improve outcomes for patients facing advanced cardiovascular disease.

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, resource forecasts, and risk management strategies.

* Ensure alignment between software, hardware, systems, and business deliverables.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and resource constraints and drive timely resolution.
* Facilitate project reviews and communicate status, key decisions, and risks to stakeholders and leadership.
* Support compliance with design controls, software lifecycle processes, risk management practices, and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality and development efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline.
* 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, software engineering, systems engineering, quality engineering, or related technical roles.
* Experience leading or supporting software development projects with cross-functional teams.
* Understanding of software development lifecycles and project execution methodologies.
* Experience managing project schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business functions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).
* Experience with connected medical devices, digital health platforms, mobile applications, cloud-based healthcare solutions, or remote patient management technologies.
* Experience working in a regulated medical device or healthcare environment.
* Familiarity with IEC 62304 (Medical Device Software – Software Life Cycle Processes), ISO 14971, FDA software guidance, cybersecurity requirements, and design control processes.
* Experience supporting integrated hardware and software product development programs.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or hybrid software development methodologies.
* Background in software engineering, systems engineering, design quality, or product development.
* PMP, Agile, Scrum Master, or equivalent certifications.

Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives: www.abbottbenefits.com

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott, and on Twitter @AbbottNews.

You will coordinate closely with USCG stakeholders, cross-functional engineering teams, field technicians, and vendor partners to ensure smooth technology upgrades with minimal operational disruption. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation's top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

**Network Security Engineer**

**General Description**

GuidePoint Security is seeking an individual to support the Detection and Automation Engineering (DAE) program by designing, implementing, and maintaining automated/Super Intelligence security detection, integration capabilities across enterprise security monitoring technologies. The individual will strengthen threat detection and response through detection engineering, security automation, systems integration, data analysis, super intelligent and continuous improvement of detection content and workflows. The role requires close collaboration with security operations, threat intelligence, and incident response stakeholders, along with strong documentation and operationalization practices.

**About the Federal Region**

GuidePoint Security is the trusted partner that defense and civilian government agencies rely on to lead their cybersecurity efforts and protect their organizations. We help solve their most complex security challenges, mature security architectures, and proactively reduce risk. Our purpose-built solutions ensure compliance, safeguard critical assets, and align security with organizational objectives. Backed by deep expertise, strong partnerships, and advanced technologies, we deliver scalable, adaptive capabilities that evolve with the threat landscape so Federal agencies can lead with confidence and protect what's next.

  

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Detection Engineering & Automation/SI: Build automation/SI and integration workflows to improve detection and response.
* Security platform integration: Integrate and optimize security technologies (e.g., SIEM, EDR, SOAR, threat intelligence) into a cohesive detection architecture.
* Requirements-to-implementation: Perform requirements analysis and translate operational security needs into technical specifications and implementable solutions.
* Testing & validation: Execute testing, evaluation, and validation of detections and automation/SI workflows; drive continuous improvements based on results and operational feedback.
* Security data analysis: Analyze telemetry to identify anomalies, trends, and detection gaps; recommend and implement detection enhancements.
* Documentation & sustainment: Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and runbooks to support reliable operations.
* Cross-functional coordination: Work closely with SOC, threat intelligence, and incident response teams to align detections to threat priorities and operational processes.
* Emerging capability evaluation: Research and assess new security and SI/ML capabilities to enhance detection effectiveness.

  

**Required Experience and Education**

* A minimum of eight (8) years' relevant experience.
* A degree from an accredited College/University in the applicable field of services is required. If the individual's degree is not in the applicable field, then four additional years of related experience is required.

jobs.description:
**Halvik Corp** delivers a wide range of services to 13 executive agencies and 15 independent agencies. Halvik is a highly successful WOB business with more than 50 prime contracts and 500+ professionals delivering Digital Services, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Cyber Security and Cutting-Edge Technology across the US Government. Be a part of something special!

**Position Overview**

Halvik is seeking a Senior Business Analyst / QA Analyst / Trainer to support the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) Office of the Chief DigitalInformation Officer (OCDIO) Digital Factory capacity task order. Operating under DOT's IT Modernization Initiative (ITIM-2025-007) and the 2025–2029 "Path to 1DOT IT" strategy, the program delivers modernized, secure, and resilient applications through a Software Factory, Capacity-as-a-Service (CaaS) model. Halvik provides Agile Scrum teams for Development, Modernization, and Enhancement (DME) work, along with tiered Operations, Maintenance, and Enhancement (OM&E) support for a portfolio of DOT mission applications hosted within the USDOT IT security boundary.

This multidisciplinary role bridges business needs, product quality, and user adoption. The Senior Business Analyst / QA Analyst / Trainer translates business requirements into clear, testable backlog items; leads quality assurance activities under the program's Mandatory Iteration-Level TestingValidation Framework; and develops training materials and delivers instructor-led sessions so stakeholders are fully enabled to use new or enhanced system capabilities. The position contributes directly to the end-client's objectives by ensuring that every release is accurate to mission requirements, meets the Definition of Done, keeps defect rates low, and is adopted successfully by DOT users.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Execution**: Lead requirements elicitation during Discovery Sessions and ongoing backlog refinement, translating business needs into well-formed user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria (including security-relevant criteria) that trace back to the MVP/MBI Roadmap and are ready for sprint planning.
* **Operational Oversight**: Manage day-to-day QA workflows across Development, QA, UAT/Staging, and Production environments. Ensure each backlog item, defect, enhancement, and release candidate meets the Definition of Done, with objective test evidence (executed scripts, screenshots, logs, and pass/fail results) attached to the Government-furnished Jira ticket before work is marked complete.
* **Collaboration**: Coordinate with the Government Product Owner, Operating Administration stakeholders, the Scrum Master, developers, and the ISSO to clarify requirements, run sprint demonstrations, coordinate user acceptance testing, and solicit user feedback. Organize that feedback in a clear, traceable way and manage it within Government-provided ticketing systems.
* **Technical Performance**: Plan and execute risk-based testing across the required categories, including smoke, end-to-end, scenario-based, persona-based, regression, integration/API, data integrity, Section 508 (WCAG 2.0 A/AA) accessibility, configuration, and release-readiness testing. Help keep the defect rate below the program's five percent Maximum Allowable Defect Rate (MADR) and monitor the health of the defect backlog.
* **Test Documentation and Automation**: Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, and scenario and persona scripts; document the rationale for any testing category not performed; and support the progressive transition from manual to automated testing as Government tools become available.
* **OM&E Quality Support**: Validate defect fixes, security patches, configuration changes, hotfixes, and minor enhancements for supported systems, ensuring smoke, end-to-end, scenario-based, and persona-based testing is completed and documented before deployment approval, including post-deployment validation in Production.
* **Data Migration Validation**: Support legacy modernization efforts by validating data mappings and transformations, performing pre- and post-migration checks and reconciliations, and coordinating Government user acceptance of migrated data before production cutover.
* **Training Developmen**t: Develop and maintain formal training plans and materials, including user guides, quick reference cards, job aids, e-learning modules, and User's Manuals, updating them in parallel with major system releases and incorporating them into sprint planning.
* **Training Delivery**: Deliver instructor-led training (virtual or in-person) to groups of roughly 25–50 end users per major release, with demonstrations, Q&A, and hands-on exercises, and conduct train-the-trainer sessions for DOT personnel who will serve as subject matter experts within their Operating Administrations.
* **Training Evaluation and Records**: Provide training schedules, agendas, and materials to the Government at least two weeks before each event; maintain attendance records and submit them within five business days; and collect participant feedback through surveys or interviews to continuously improve training content and methods.

**Minimum Requirements**

* **Education**: Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, Education/Instructional Design, or a related field.
* **Experience**: Minimum of 7 years of professional experience in IT business analysis, software quality assurance, and/or end-user training, including at least 3 years supporting Agile Scrum teams in a Federal Government environment.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Advanced knowledge of Jira (including test evidence and defect tracking), Confluence, and Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams). Hands-on experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria, developing and executing test cases, and producing training materials; working familiarity with Section 508 accessibility te

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview:

LMI is seeking a Data Analyst to support Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives. These full-time positions provide hands-on analytical capacity across AI-enabled use cases, operational improvement, workflow modernization, performance measurement, reporting, data-quality assessment, and decision support.

The Data Analysts will use SQL and Python as core day-to-day tools to acquire, prepare, validate, analyze, and automate data workflows. They will also support AI-enabled analysis and solution evaluation by preparing evaluation datasets, assessing AI-generated outputs, identifying data-quality and grounding issues, measuring performance, and helping teams distinguish useful AI-assisted insights from unsupported or unreliable results.

The role works closely with the Senior AI Lead, Data Science Lead, data integration, program evaluation, clinical informatics, delivery, and technical teams. These analysts are not expected to replace data scientists or AI engineers; they provide the scalable analytical execution, validation, and evidence needed to move multiple AI and modernization workstreams forward responsibly.

Candidates should independently execute well-scoped analyses and recurring analytical products. Candidates should own more complex multi-source and AI-enabled analyses, shape analytical approaches, review work, and advise stakeholders. Strong candidates combine practical AI experience with strong SQL and Python skills, disciplined documentation, data-quality judgment, and concise communication.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

* Perform quality assurance and reasonableness checks before findings are released; escalate data, AI-output, or methodology concerns that could materially change conclusions.

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, operations research, computer science, information systems, public health, engineering, or a related quantitative field; equivalent experience may be considered.

Bachelor's degree in human resources, business administration, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience where permitted by the contract.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst, Application Development - US
jobs.description:
**Work Location / Type:**

  

* This is an onsite role based in the our Florham Park, NJ office
* Hours: 9:00AM - 6:00PM US Eastern Time.

  

**About the Role:**

  

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will own the requirements for every application our Application Development team builds, from internal tools to customer-facing web applications. You will embed with our operations, finance, sales, and other business teams to understand how work really gets done, then turn what you learn into clear requirements, process flows, and specifications that our full-stack developers can build from. AI is central to how you will work: you will use AI tools to synthesize discovery, draft requirements and process flows, build quick prototypes, and write structured specifications that both developers and AI coding agents can work from. You will report to the Business Analyst Team Lead and work closely with developers, designers, QA, and business stakeholders around the world. The quality of your requirements, and of your communication, sets the quality of every release.

  

**What you will do:**

* + Own the requirements for all applications in the Application Development portfolio, from the first conversation with the business through release, adoption, and continuous improvement.

  + Run discovery sessions, workshops, and interviews with business users and stakeholders to document current processes, surface pain points, and define future-state solutions.

  + Write clear, build-ready requirements, including user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, data models, field-level mappings, and functional and technical specifications.

  + Use AI tools throughout the requirements lifecycle to synthesize discovery notes, draft requirements and user stories, generate acceptance criteria and test scenarios, and create process flows and diagrams, validating every output for accuracy and completeness.

  + Build quick, clickable prototypes with AI prototyping tools to validate ideas with stakeholders before development begins.

  + Write structured, implementation-ready specifications that support spec-driven development, so developers and AI coding agents can build accurately from them.

  + Model current and future-state processes using BPMN or similar standards, capturing edge cases, dependencies, and non-functional requirements such as security, performance, and auditability.

  + Define integration requirements between our applications, NetSuite (ERP), and external partner systems, working with developers on APIs and data flows.

  + Facilitate decisions across stakeholder groups, resolve conflicting requirements, and secure sign-off without escalating every open question.

  + Partner with developers, designers, and QA through backlog refinement, sprint planning, and daily delivery, keeping scope, priorities, and open questions clear.

  + Maintain traceability from business objectives through epics, user stories, test cases, and release.

  + Demonstrate completed features to business users, support user acceptance testing (UAT) with QA, and manage the promotion of approved work into production.

  + Build business cases and value analysis to prioritize and justify development investments.

  + Provide functional production support, including issue triage and root cause analysis, and drive improvements based on usage data and user feedback.

  + Prepare business teams for new releases through demos, training, job aids, and release communications.

  + Review requirements written by other analysts, mentor less experienced team members, and help set the standard for how the team documents and delivers.

  

**We are Seeking People Who:**

* + Have a bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, business analytics, industrial engineering, or a related field.

jobs.description:
**Description**

### **Illuminate Emerging Adversary Campaigns Across the Pacific Cyberspace Frontier**

Leidos is seeking an experienced, analytical **Cyber Threat Analyst** to join our Defensive Cyber Operations (DCO) team supporting Defense Information Systems Agency Pacific (DISA PAC) at Ford Island, Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, HI. Operating under the Global Services Management – Operations II (GSM-O II) Task Order 22 (TN22) Boundary Cyber Defense and Cybersecurity Services Provider (CSSP) contract, our mission is to defend the Department of Defense Information Network (DODIN/DISN), U.S. Pacific Command (USPACOM), and critical mission partner enclaves against sophisticated advanced persistent threats and nation-state cyber actors.

In this high-impact intelligence and analysis role, you will synthesize multi-source intelligence, telemetry, and forensic data into actionable threat intelligence. You will analyze adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), formulate threat indicators, track advanced adversary campaigns, and direct threat-informed defense operations across perimeter boundaries, multi-cloud platforms, and classified networks—spanning Unclassified (NIPRNet) and Secret (SIPRNet) up to Top Secret/SCI.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **1. Boundary Threat Analysis & Adversary Characterization**

* **Warning Intelligence & Attack Sensing:** Analyze boundary sensor feeds, Netflow, and IDS/IPS logs in conjunction with intelligence agencies, peer CSSPs, and commercial intelligence providers to deliver Warning Intelligence and Attack Sensing and Warning activities compliant with DoDI 8530.01.
* **Adversary Campaign Tracking:** Apply the **MITRE ATT&CK®** and Cyber Kill Chain frameworks to characterize adversary behavior, track campaign evolution, identify "Living off the Land" (LotL) tradecraft, and assess the operational impact of targeted threats traversing enterprise Internet Access Points and Boundary Cloud Access Points.
* **Actionable Battlefield Intelligence:** Author, refine, and disseminate high-impact, actionable battlefield cyber threat analysis products, Threat Warnings, and Tippers that empower tactical defenders and boundary engineers to preempt emerging cyber assaults.
* **Automated Telemetry & Breach Assessment:** Evaluate bypasses and telemetry from automated blocking platforms to uncover adversary evasion techniques, evaluate malicious patterns, and generate targeted analytic hypotheses.
* **Operational Reporting & DJOC Synchronization:** Coordinate closely with the DISA Joint Operations Center (DJOC), USPACOM J6, DoD Cyber Defense Command (DCDC), USCYBERCOM, and the National Security Agency (NSA) to synchronize threat analyses and maintain standardized incident reporting in the DoD-mandated reporting structure (currently Rally).

### **2. Enterprise CSSP Intelligence & Proactive Threat Hunting**

* **Deliberate Defense (DD) & Discovery Counter Infiltration (DCI):** Formulate threat hypotheses based on all-source intelligence, reconstruct multi-stage adversary attack paths, and conduct structured threat-hunting across enterprise endpoints and cloud enclaves to validate malicious presence or confirm its absence.
* **Multi-Cloud & Zero Trust Threat Analysis:** Track advanced persistent threats operating against enterprise cloud ecosystems (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) secured under the Joint Warfighter Cloud Capability, Thunderdome Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and Microsoft Defender suite (EndGuard).
* **Analytic Capability & Use Case Development:** Translate threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into specific detection use cases, rule logic, and detection requirements for ingestion into enterprise SIEMs (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, and JCRS-D).
* **Aggregated Threat Trend Reporting:** Aggregate threat indicators, malware behaviors, and adversary profiles from commercial threat feeds (e.g., CrowdStrike, VirusTotal) and internal investigations; provide inputs for the quarterly Aggregated Cyber Awareness Report detailing strategic threat forecasts and vulnerability exposures.
* **Vulnerability & Exposure Intelligence:** Continuously assess Information Assurance Vulnerability Management notices (IAVAs and IAVBs) against active adversary exploitation trends, providing technical threat context and impact assessments to mission partner enclaves.

### **3. Location-Specific & Above-Secret Intelligence: PACOM & TS/SCI**

* **PACOM Mission Network (PMN) and Joint Operational Edge – Coalition Environment (JOE-CE) Threat Assessment:** Provide dedicated cyber threat intelligence and behavioral profiling tailored to the PMN and JOE-CE operational networks.
* **User & Entity Behavioral Profiling:** Analyze Identity, Credential, and Access Management telemetry and the PMN Master User Record to identify anomalous user behavior, insider threats, and sophisticated lateral movement.
* **SCIF-Based Intelligence Operations:** Conduct all-source cyber analysis within Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIF) at Ford Island, examining multi-discipline intelligence across JWICS, YLAN, and special-access enclaves up to Top Secret / SCI.
* **Cross-Echelon Coordination:** Brief Senior Executive and military leadership across USPACOM, DISA PAC, and operational mission partners on adversary threat capabilities, active campaigns, and strategic risk postures.

**What You’ll Need for Success**
--------------------------------

### **Clearance & Citizenship**

* **Citizenship:** Must be a U.S. Citizen.
* **Clearance:** Active **Top Secret** security clearance with eligibility to obtain SCI access upon start (adjudicated Tier 5 / SSBI investigation within scope). *Candidates holding an active Secret clearance may be considered provided Top Secret/SCI processing begins immediately upon hire with government approval.*

* Bachelor’s degree with **4+ ye

**Summary**
-----------

This position is in the Department of Defense Special Access Program Central Office (DoD SAPCO). The Director ofDoD SAPCO serves as the senior official and advisor to the Secretary of Defense (SD) and the Deputy Secretary of Defense (DSD) for oversight and governance ofDoD special access programs. The DoD SAPCO is responsible for developing and implementing policies and procedures for DoD Special Access Program (SAP) execution, management, and administration.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**

Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.

### **Veterans**

Veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces or a spouse, widow, widower or parent of a veteran, who may be eligible for derived preference

### **Military spouses**

Military spouses of active duty service members or whose spouse is 100 percent disabled or died on active duty.

### **Clarification from the agency**

U.S. citizens

  

**Duties**
----------

Incumbent typical work assignments may include the following:

* Serves as a Legislative Liaison Senior Advisor, and the point of contact for all inquiries from the Congressional Defense Committees and their members.
* Develops and implements policies and procedures for DoD Special Access Program (SAP) execution, management, and administration.

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* U.S. Citizenship is required
* Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered or exempt from Selective Service (see https://www.sss.gov/Home/Registration)
* May be required to successfully complete a probationary/trial period
* Must be determined suitable for federal employment
* Required to participate in the direct deposit program
* This position is subject to pre-employment and random drug testing

* Required to handle and safeguard sensitive and/or classified information in accordance with regulations to reduce potential compromise.
* This is not a telework position.

### **Qualifications**

**In order to qualify for this position, you must meet the requirements described below.**  
  
  
  
**You may qualify at the** **GS-15** **level, if you fulfill the following qualification requirement:**
  
  
One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-14 grade level in the Federal service (experience may have been gained in the private sector) that demonstrates your ability in:

* Applying complex legislative and regulatory guidance to established or recommended implementing policy and/or resolve very difficult program analysis problems/issues.
* Developing and implementing policies and procedures for special access programs.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.
  
  
**All qualifications and education requirements must be met by the closing date of this announcement and clearly documented in your resume.**

If a determination is not able to be made about the duration of your creditable experience for qualification requirements, you will be removed from consideration.**
  
  
**Read more about what should I include in my federal resume** at https://help.usajobs.gov/faq/application/documents/resume/what-to-include

jobs.title: Customer Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
At Flexciton, we work with high-tech factories built with investments worth hundreds of millions of dollars, producing advanced chips at the atomic level. It can take up to nine months to fabricate these cutting-edge products.

We are proud to be the only SaaS product in the world that plans and schedules production in high-tech semiconductor fabs, using complex algorithms in real-time, all from our London office.

Our technology consistently delivers the best production schedules, and leading companies like Seagate trust Flexciton to run their production 24/7. With operations across the US, Europe, and expansion into Asia, we are on a path to realise our vision for the Autonomous Factory.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Customer Implementation Manager owns the end-to-end delivery of our software into enterprise semiconductor manufacturing environments — a highly technical product in a demanding, fast-moving setting where priorities shift and clear thinking under pressure is what generates great customer outcomes. You run complex implementation projects from kickoff to go-live, often across more than one customer at a time depending on project stage, using expert project-management, data, communication and collaboration skills. After rollout, you continue to own the account — maximising the success, adoption and value our software delivers. You will also contribute to the strategic direction of the function, improving processes and ways of working.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Implementation Delivery: Owns the delivery of customer implementation projects end-to-end — coordinating key stakeholders, documentation and plans, and navigating shifting priorities across factory operations, engineering and commercial stakeholders without losing the thread. Drives project success under time constraints. Runs the client engagement cadence (regular calls, QBRs) and coordinates across Product & Engineering to keep delivery on track.
* Product Expertise & Influence: Deep understanding of our applications and all complex features, and how they integrate into each customer's environment. Works with Product and other Client Success team members to translate customer requests into structured requirements.
* Value & Outcome Realisation: Translates factory performance goals into measurable customer value, and ensures that value is realised and evidenced post-rollout. Improves metrics such as time-to-value through more effective delivery.
* Adoption, Health & Renewal Support: Owns customer health and adoption across the account lifecycle, proactively monitoring usage, running check-ins and business reviews, and identifying at-risk accounts early. Surfaces and qualifies renewal risk and expansion opportunities and hands them to Account Management.
* Risk & Escalation Management: Acts as the customer's technical anchor during difficult periods, diagnosing issues under time pressure, coordinating Product & Engineering to resolution, and maintaining executive trust throughout.

**What success looks like in this role**
----------------------------------------

* You independently manage and deliver complex implementation projects end-to-end, typically spanning 9–15 months.

* You become the client's trusted technical anchor, trusted to hold the relationship through difficult moments.

jobs.title: Business Analyst (Market Research and Techno-economics)
jobs.description:
Business Analyst (Market Research and Techno-economics)

Location: Cambridge, UK  
Salary: £53,548 per annum + pension  
Hours: Full time  
Contract: Permanent  
Start date: As soon as the right candidate is available  
Closing date: Open until filled

About LeafyColl

LeafyColl is a Cambridge-based biotechnology company producing human-identical proteins in plants. Our first product is bioidentical human collagen, supplied as a B2B ingredient for cosmeceuticals, with medical devices and functional food to follow. We work with contract manufacturers and leading academic and industry partners. We are a small, collaborative and fast-moving team where everyone has real ownership of their work and a direct impact on the business.

The Role

We are looking for a Business Analyst to provide the research, data and financial analysis behind LeafyColl’s commercial and growth decisions. You will design and run market and stakeholder research, analyse data rigorously, build cost and financial models, and turn your findings into clear recommendations for our leadership team, partners, investors and funders. You will also coordinate suppliers and project reporting across our commercial and collaborative R&D activities.

Our primary requirement is strong business research and quantitative analysis skills, with proven experience of designing studies, collecting primary data and turning results into recommendations.

You will:

* Design and carry out market and customer research, including surveys, questionnaires and stakeholder interviews with brands, manufacturers, clinicians and partners.
* Analyse quantitative and qualitative data using statistical methods, and present findings in clear reports and presentations.
* Analyse our target markets (cosmeceuticals, medical devices and functional food), including market size, segments, competitors, pricing and barriers to adoption.
* Build and maintain financial and cost models, including unit economics, pricing, cost of goods and sensitivity analysis, working with our scientific team on production data.
* Support techno-economic and sustainability analysis, including collecting process data for cost and life-cycle assessments that compare our proteins with animal-derived and fermentation-derived alternatives.
* Assess business models, including ingredient supply and licensing, and turn customer insight and our partner pipeline into demand forecasts and go-to-market recommendations.
* Coordinate suppliers, contract manufacturers and logistics, tracking costs, timelines and performance.
* Support LeafyColl’s collaborative R&D projects, including research and analysis for grant applications, project reports, and budget and milestone tracking.
* Carry out literature and policy reviews on markets, regulation and sustainability to inform strategy.
* Prepare evidence, models and presentations for strategic planning, board reporting, fundraising and partner discussions.

Essential Skills, Experience and Qualifications

* A master’s degree in international business, business, finance, economics, management or a related discipline.
* Experience of designing surveys or questionnaires and collecting primary quantitative and qualitative data.
* Strong statistical analysis skills using SPSS or similar software, and good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
* Sound understanding of finance, accounting or financial analysis.
* Experience writing research reports and presenting findings to professional or academic audiences.
* Experience of working with stakeholders and suppliers, and of managing your own workload and projects independently.

Desirable Skills

* Advanced statistical methods, such as regression or structural equation modelling (for example with SmartPLS).
* Experience of running or managing operations in a small business, including scheduling, budgets and vendor relationships.
* Systematic literature review and reference management (for example EndNote or Mendeley).
* Interest in, or experience of, biotechnology, life sciences or sustainability, including life-cycle assessment.
* Experience contributing to grant-funded or academic research projects.

You do not need every desirable skill to apply. Training in sector-specific tools will be provided.

What We Offer

* £53,548 per annum, plus company pension.
* A permanent, full-time position.
* Broad exposure across science, operations, commercial strategy and fundraising in a fast-paced, collaborative start-up.
* Professional development, training and work with leading academic and industry partners.

How to Apply

Please email the following to Dr Ejaz Hussain at ejaz@leafycoll.co.uk, using the subject line “Business Analyst application”:

* Your CV.
* A cover letter (maximum two pages) explaining how you meet the essential criteria, with one or two examples of research or analysis you have personally carried out, the methods you used and how your findings informed decisions.

Interviews will include a short presentation on a piece of research or analysis you have carried out.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. Informal enquiries are welcome at the same email address.

LeafyColl is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds. Personal data submitted with applications will be used only for recruitment and handled in line with UK GDPR.

Pay: £48,548.00-£53,548.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering assigned IT projects in accordance with FTA’s project governance framework, approved scope, schedule, budget, quality standards, and business objectives. The role manages project teams and stakeholders, monitors progress and risks, maintains project documentation and reporting, and escalates issues requiring management decisions.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Initiate and plan projects by defining objectives, scope, deliverables, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, assumptions, and success measures.

* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, work breakdown structures, resource plans, budgets, and risk, issue, assumption, and dependency logs.

* Coordinate business owners, IT teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure clear responsibilities, timely decisions, and effective delivery.

* Monitor project performance against approved baselines; track milestones, costs, resources, deliverables, and benefits; and recommend corrective actions when variances arise.

* Prepare regular project status reports, dashboards, steering committee updates, and escalation papers using PMO-approved templates and tools.

* Identify, assess, manage, and escalate project risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes, and delivery blockers in line with PMO governance and change-control procedures.

* Manage vendor and outsourced team performance against agreed deliverables, service levels, contractual obligations, timelines, and quality expectations.

* Coordinate requirements, solution design, testing, user acceptance, deployment, transition to operations, and project closure, ensuring approvals and acceptance criteria are met.

* Maintain complete and accurate project documentation, decisions, approvals, lessons learned, and benefits-realisation information in the designated project management system.

* Ensure project activities comply with FTA policies, information security requirements, procurement and contract processes, and applicable regulatory obligations.

* Facilitate project meetings and workshops, follow up on actions, resolve conflicts, and communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels.

* Support portfolio reporting, resource planning, project prioritisation, and continuous improvement of PMO practices as required.

  
  
**Requirements**

Minimum:

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from PMI — mandatory and valid.

Preferred:

* Additional recognised certification in Agile, PRINCE2, programme/project management, business analysis, or risk management.

**Work Experience**

**Minimum:**

* At least 3 years of proven professional experience working as a Project Manager, with responsibility for planning and delivering projects end to end and 8+ overall experience.

* Experience managing project schedules, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, stakeholders, and project reporting.

* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing vendors or outsourced delivery teams.

**Preferred:**

* Experience delivering IT, digital transformation, systems implementation, or enterprise technology projects.

* Experience working within a formal PMO, project governance framework, and change-control process.

* Knowledge of project financial management, resource planning, procurement, and contract management.

Volund is building propulsion for America’s next industrial revolution.  
We design propulsion systems for cost, agility, and scale, combining advanced automation, precision manufacturing, and rapid iteration to move from prototype to production at unprecedented speed.

At Volund, engineers operate across the full stack, from concept and simulation to process code and machine execution, ensuring that what is designed can be built and what is built can be scaled.  
  
**Role Overview:**

Volund is looking for a Business Operations Manager to work directly with the Chief Operating Officer on high-priority business initiatives across the company.

Business Operations sits between functions. The role focuses on problems that do not fit neatly within Finance, Operations, Engineering, HR, or another single team.

You will help evaluate opportunities, improve business systems and processes, develop analyses for important decisions, and drive cross-functional initiatives from an initial question through implementation.

* High personal accountability and follow-through.

Volund’s Operations organization owns the physical operating system of the factory, including supply chain, production planning, manufacturing operations, inventory, material flow, facilities, ERP/MRP execution, and factory performance.

jobs.description:

Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

As the Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM), you will lead the organization’s cybersecurity program, ensuring information systems operate securely and in compliance with regulatory and company requirements. This role drives risk management, authorization activities, continuous monitoring, incident response, and security governance while partnering across multiple functions to support secure business operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Manages the cybersecurity governance framework aligned with the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and company policies, including policies, standards, and continuous monitoring plans.
* Leads enterprise risk assessments, advises leadership on system authorizations, and drives remediation activities.
* Oversees compliance, continuous monitoring, and incident response activities for information systems.
* Leads and mentors Information System Security Officers (ISSOs) and security personnel to strengthen security practices across operations.
* Coordinates inspections, vulnerability management activities, audit readiness efforts, and corrective actions.
* Reviews and analyzes security logs and events, triages incidents, and documents required actions in accordance with regulatory requirements.
* Supports insider threat and security investigation activities in partnership with Human Resources, Legal, and Physical Security teams.
* Supports communications security (COMSEC), operations security (OPSEC), and the implementation of security controls for restricted work environments.
* Oversees physical security system support activities, including access control, alarm systems, and video surveillance.
* Develops and delivers security awareness training, compliance reporting, and dashboards related to vulnerabilities, remediation, inspections, and system compliance.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Minimum one year of experience in information systems security, cybersecurity compliance, or a related field.
* Experience with RMF, National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) frameworks, or similar cybersecurity frameworks.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree.
* Experience supporting classified environments and government compliance requirements.
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or equivalent certification.

**We're hiring for this role at multiple levels. If you don't meet every qualification listed but believe you'd be a strong fit, we encourage you to apply. Your experience will help us determine the level that's right for you.**

Program Leadership & Planning

* Serve as the primary cross-functional leader responsible for aligning technical execution, business priorities, and program outcomes.

**About the Opportunity:**

Melissa is looking for a curious, detail-oriented, and technically capable data professional to help maintain and improve the quality of some of our most important proprietary data assets. At Melissa, we develop data quality and identity solutions that help organizations maintain accurate, reliable, and connected information.

We are looking for someone to take a hands-on role in understanding, analyzing, validating, and continuously improving these identifiers. You will work directly with large datasets, investigate data anomalies, develop quality checks, evaluate changes, and collaborate with technical teams to ensure our identifiers remain accurate, consistent, and reliable. This is an opportunity to develop deep expertise in data quality, identity resolution, and large-scale data management while taking ownership of data assets used by Melissa's customers.

**What You Will Do:**

jobs.title: Strategy and Operations Manager, AI-Native Business Operations
jobs.description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

**Strategy and Operations Manager, AI-Native Business Operations**
==================================================================

San Jose, California, United States

**Job category:** Business Operations **Job ID:** 137017-en\_US

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role helps the leaders of NetApp's product organization decide where people and money go, and makes those decisions faster and better informed. It spans planning, forecasting and tracking the organization's people and resources, and the budget across headcount, open reqs, software, cloud and AI spend. On each of these the analyst brings a point of view, not just the numbers behind it.

The role combines three skillsets that usually live in three different people: the consultant who frames an ambiguous question and lands a recommendation with senior leaders; the analyst who builds the model and can defend every number in it; and the AI-first builder who turns recurring work into systems that run themselves. The unit of delivery is a better decision, made sooner, on numbers leaders trust.

The role sits within the AI-Native Business Operations team in the product organization, and reports to the Director, AI-Native Business Operations. The team works in close partnership with Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition and engineering leadership across the product organization.

A few principles shape how the team approaches its work:

* **We start from outcomes, not from tasks.** The first question on any piece of work is what it is for and what good looks like, not how to automate the current steps.
* **One source of truth.** People, plans and spend live in one trusted, connected source, and every report and dashboard draws from it.
* **AI first, with human judgment throughout.** AI shortens the time to an outcome; our judgment tests every assumption and validates each step, from the source data to the final recommendation.
* **Accountability does not stop at the answer.** The analyst stands behind the method and the data as well as the result.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Plan, forecast and track.** Build the plans and forecasts for the product organization's people and resources, and track them month by month: where engineering capacity and spend go across products and investment themes, and how hiring, attrition and backfills move against plan.
* **Manage the budget.** Hold the product organization's spend against target with Finance, from headcount and open reqs to software, cloud and AI, and find where to consolidate, renegotiate or stop.
* **Advise product leadership.** Turn the numbers into a clear point of view for vice presidents and their staff, and run the planning cycles and leadership reviews where those decisions get made.
* **Operationalize strategic initiatives.** Take a leadership priority from idea to working program: define its scope, set milestones and checkpoints, build the plan and put it in motion, then measure the results and keep leadership updated as it lands.
* **Automate the recurring work.** Build agents, automations and dashboards with Claude and the team's other AI tools that make each cycle take less effort than the last.
* **Keep the source of truth trustworthy.** Maintain the connected data behind every leadership view, with the checks and audit trail that let a leader defend any figure in front of Finance or the executive staff.
* **Work across functions.** Partner with Finance, HR, Talent Acquisition, IT and data owners on access, definitions and changes, within NetApp standards for privacy and acceptable use.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience, including a minimum of 3 years in consulting. This experience may have been gained in:

* The strategy, operations or analytics practice of a management consulting firm, such as McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Deloitte, or a comparable practice
* A business operations, strategy and operations, or FP&A team at an AI-first technology company
* A founding or early operating role at a startup building AI-native products

* Uses AI as the default way of working, across analysis, writing and building, with examples to show, and builds validation into each step so the speed never costs accuracy. Familiarity with Claude Code or Cursor is preferred.
* Learns new domains, systems and data quickly, and acts without waiting for a perfect brief; comfortable where the problem is still being defined.
* Expert scenario and financial modeling: headcount, cost and what-if models that leaders use to make decisions, and the judgment to spot when a number is wrong.
* A technical, hands-on approach to data: reads data architectures and table schemas, writes the joins in SQL or Python, and treats data preparation as part of the job, from cleaning and de-duplicating records to validating formats and keys before any number is used. Experience with workforce or finance data in systems such as Workday or Snowflake is a plus.
* A track record of influencing directors and vice presidents without authority, with recommendations that were acted on.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to disagree productively and adjust as evidence evolve

Job-related experience, 8 years
  
  
**Desired:**  
Master's Degree or equivalent experience.

Description:

Beveridge & Diamond, P.C., the foremost national corporate environmental law firm, is seeking an eDiscovery Project Manager to lead the planning and execution of complex electronic discovery matters across the litigation lifecycle.

Working under the general direction of the Director of Litigation Support & eDiscovery, the Project Manager serves as the primary operational lead for assigned matters and partners with attorneys, litigation support professionals, review teams, clients, and external service providers to deliver efficient, accurate, and defensible discovery solutions. The role applies advanced eDiscovery expertise and independent judgment to manage competing priorities, identify and mitigate project risks, recommend technical approaches, and maintain accountability for project outcomes.

The Project Manager operates with significant autonomy in the execution of assigned matters while escalating substantive legal decisions and significant strategic, financial, staffing, technology-investment, or departmental matters to the Director or responsible case team.

At Beveridge & Diamond, we do not just practice environmental law—we define it. With more than 170 lawyers across seven U.S. offices and a legacy spanning five decades, we are The Environmental Law Firm. * Translate attorney-approved discovery requirements into processing and production specifications and work with technical personnel and vendors to confirm data completeness, metadata accuracy, document relationships, and resolution of processing exceptions.

* Coordinate with Staff Attorneys and case teams regarding document review workflows, batching plans, reviewer guidance, review protocols, privilege-review quality checks, privilege-log preparation, and progress reporting under attorney direction.
* Translate technical information into practical recommendations that support informed case-team decisions.
* Facilitate communication and accountability among internal personnel, external vendors, and other project stakeholders.

**Related Litigation Data Projects and Process Improvement**

* Coordinate related litigation data projects, including Plaintiff Fact Sheet tracking, deficiency monitoring, reporting, and case or transcript management,

In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

**About the role**

Nerdio is hiring a Digital Program Manager to orchestrate the scaled customer experience across Customer Success. You will own the automated journeys end to end, and act as an internal consultant to the rest of the CS organization: finding friction in the customer journey and removing it with automation and agentic AI.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success and work alongside the Pooled CS team, but your reach is wider: the plays you build are designed for reuse across Customer Success, so customers get one seamless experience no matter who owns the moment. This is a builder role with no named book of business. You bring the ownership and customer-first urgency of a CAM or TAM to cross-functional programs, and you are comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity.

**What you'll do**

**Orchestrate the scaled customer experience**

* Own the digital journey from onboarding through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion readiness. Build, launch, monitor, and iterate the plays and automations at each stage.
* Build the triggers and handoffs that bring in a CAM or TAM at the right moment (health thresholds, renewal risk, expansion signals, escalations, champion changes, customer requests), following the coverage model set by the strategy lead.
* Deliver against the current and future-state journey maps owned by the strategy lead. Surface the friction points you find in the data and in the field, and close them so the experience feels the same regardless of who owns the moment.

**Act as an internal consultant to Customer Success**

* Lead discovery with CS teams: ticket analysis, stakeholder interviews, and data review to find where manual, repetitive, or inconsistent work hurts customers or burns CAM/TAM capacity.
* Recommend and build the fix: automation, signal-based triggers, and agentic AI. Give teams plays they can turn on today.

**Lead agentic AI and automation**

* Move the program from static plays to adaptive, agentic journeys for higher-complexity moments, such as personalized onboarding and automated EBR/TVR one-pagers.
* Equip CAMs and TAMs with agentic insights that make their jobs easier and return capacity to them.
* Evaluate tools, run pilots, and set guardrails so AI-driven touches are accurate, on-brand, and hand off to a human when one is needed.

**Run the program and the partnerships**

* Own program and project management from discovery to launch to iteration: scope, plan, sequence, and keep a current view of the roadmap, status, and dependencies.
* Partner with Marketing on every lifecycle communication, RevOps on segmentation and metrics, Product on telemetry and in-app messaging, Support on ticket signals, and Sales on expansion.
* Prove impact. Tie each play to NRR, adoption, and risk reduction, run test-and-learn cycles, and share results broadly.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in digital customer success, lifecycle or adoption marketing, CS operations, or program management for a scaled customer segment.
* A track record of leading cross-functional programs from idea to launch and influencing partners without direct authority.
* A consultative approach: you can run discovery, facilitate working sessions, and turn what you hear into a prioritized plan.
* Hands-on experience with CS, marketing automation, or CRM platforms, and the ability to build or configure automated journeys.
* Practical experience with, or strong curiosity about, AI agents and LLM-based workflows, and sound judgment on where AI should and should not act.
* Data fluency: you use product telemetry, health scores, and attribution to choose what to build and show what worked.
* Strong prioritization, risk management, and written and verbal communication for audiences from CAMs to executives.
* A builder mentality and comfort with ambiguity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, cloud, or the Microsoft and MSP ecosystem.

* Hands-on use of no-code or low-code agent builders and prompt design.

* **Training Developmen**t: Develop and maintain formal training plans and materials, including user guides, quick reference cards, job aids, e-learning modules, and User's Manuals, updating them in parallel with major system releases and incorporating them into sprint planning.
